text:
leo: Heads up — trade just went through in the Redwood Dynasty league: I gave away Aaron Jones + 2nd rounder for Julio Jones and a late pick. link: https://fantasy.league.example/tx/98765
league-bot: Trade submitted by leo -> opponent: rachel. Waiting for league veto window (24h).
anya: wait wut, Aaron Jones for Julio? That seems backwards given Jones' ROS workload. :thinking_face:
rachel: yep that's my trade. I needed WR depth, Julio's on a hot stretch. Happy to discuss.
mike: As commish: can you post lineup/opponent context? League rules say fair-trade veto only if collusion or extreme imbalance.
leo: opponent was thin at WR, I'm trying to balance my RB depth. I know Aaron's been touchlight last 2 games but still top-20 RB.
ken: On paper I agree with anya. Our DB has been scoring high with RBs this season. I'd vote to veto if majority. :hand: :hand: 
rachel: not collusion, just roster need. I gave up a mid-tier WR + a 2nd, not like I stole a stud.
mike: Can we do a quick poll? If 3+ veto votes within 24h comp, block. Anyone care to weigh in?
anya: Veto. This swings the RB market too much for me. :no_good:  
leo: I get it. If it's vetoed I'm fine, just trying to trade from strength.
ken: lean veto. want to see other votes.
rachel: re-iterate: happy to reverse if commish decides. Not trying to game the system. :pray:
mike: noted. I'll leave final until 24h but will enforce majority rule. Will post final outcome here.
league-bot: Veto window closes in 23:58:12.
leo: Thanks for the quick takes. If this gets vetoed I'll repost a different offer. 
anya: Also pro tip for anyone trading: include projected weeks and snap% to justify. Makes vetoes less likely. :memo:
league-bot: Reminder: trade history for last 7 days: 3 trades, 1 veto. View: https://fantasy.league.example/history
